pins.name: INT
pins.notes: Data ready, optional. SATEL-style order; other boards differ

pins.name: I2C_RST
pins.notes: I2C reset, active HIGH. Tie to GND

pins.name: LPN
pins.notes: Low-power enable: HIGH to talk over I2C. Can be tied to IOVDD

pins.name: PWREN
pins.notes: Enables the on-board regulator. Tie to IOVDD

sources.title: ST VL53L5CX datasheet
sources.section: Default I2C address 0x29 (0x52 8-bit); firmware is uploaded by the host at every start (about 86 kB)

sources.title: ST UM2884 VL53L5CX ULD guide
sources.section: LPn must be HIGH to enable I2C communication
